*.ref: Bindable reference to the DOM element.
*.element: Bindable reference to the DOM element.
*.child: Renders your own element in place of the default one. Spread the given `props` onto it.
*.onclick: Called when it is clicked or activated.
*.disabled: Prevents interaction and dims the control.
*.labels: Overrides the built-in text and accessible names. Every key is optional and English is the fallback.
*.surface: Surface treatment. Omit it to inherit `--mielui-surface` from the theme.
*.open: Whether it is open. Bind it to control the state from outside.
*.onOpenChange: Called with the new state whenever it opens or closes.
*.allowClickOutside: Closes when the pointer is pressed outside it. Set false to keep it open until it is dismissed another way.
*.portal: Moves the panel to the end of the document so ancestors cannot clip it. Set false to render it in place.
*.refElement: Positions the panel against this element or virtual element instead of the trigger.
*.placement: Preferred side and alignment relative to the trigger, such as `bottom-start`. It flips when there is no room.
*.stateKey: Key that identifies this instance's state. A key is generated when you omit it.
*.hoverable: Opens on hover as well as on click.
*.delay: Milliseconds the pointer rests on the trigger before it opens.
*.closeDelay: Milliseconds after the pointer leaves before it closes.
*.type: `single` keeps one value. `multiple` allows several and makes `value` an array.
*.callback: Called when the item is chosen.
*.locale: BCP 47 locale used for names and number formats.
*.form: Id of the form this control belongs to when it sits outside that form.
*.name: Field name submitted with the form.
*.required: Requires a value before the form can be submitted.
*.readonly: Shows the value without allowing edits. The value is still submitted.
*.placeholder: Text shown while there is no value.
*.label: Visible label linked to the control.
*.description: Supporting text under the label, announced with the control.
*.aria-label: Accessible name when there is no visible label.
*.aria-labelledby: Id of the element that labels it.
*.aria-describedby: Id of the element that describes it.
*.aria-hidden: Hides it from assistive technology when it is decorative.
*.level: Heading level in the surrounding document.
*.loading: Shows the loading state in place of the content.
*.month: Month data from the Root snippet.
*.weekdays: Weekday names from the Root snippet.
*.showHeading: Shows the month name above the grid, for layouts with several months.
*.day: Custom content for each day cell.
*.sticky: Keeps the panel in view while its anchor scrolls. `partial` keeps part of it visible and `always` keeps all of it.
*.hideWhenDetached: Hides the panel when the trigger scrolls out of view.
*.part: Which part of the date this segment edits.
*.dynamic: Lets the panel grow to fit its content instead of matching the trigger width.
*.inset: Indents the item so it lines up with items that have an indicator.
*.icon: Shows the chevron after the label.
*.href: Renders a link to this address.
*.value: Current value. Bind it to control the state from outside.
*.onValueChange: Called with the new value when it changes.
*.checked: Whether it is checked. Bind it to control the state from outside.
*.onCheckedChange: Called with the new state when it changes.
*.step: Amount each step changes the value by.
*.error: Error message shown with the control.
*.status: Current state, which sets the indicator shown.
*.onError: Called with the error when the action fails.
*.errorMessage: Message shown when the action fails.
*.submitOnEnter: Enter submits and Shift+Enter adds a line. Set false to make Enter add a line.
*.autoresize: Grows with its content instead of scrolling.
*.empty: Content shown when there is nothing to list.
*.heading: Heading shown above the group.
*.onRemove: Called when the remove button is pressed.
*.accept: Accepted file types, written as for a file input.
*.title: Title text.
*.leading: Decorative content inside the field, before the text.
*.trailing: Decorative content inside the field, after the text.
*.onOpenChangeComplete: Called after the open or close animation finishes.
*.loadingLabel: Text shown while it is loading.
*.config: Label, color, and value format for each series, keyed by series.
*.animation: `reveal` animates in once, `live` keeps a subtle motion running, and `none` is static.
*.table: TanStack Table instance that drives the table.

accordion.Item.value: Identifies the item. Root's `value` holds the open item or items.
accordion.collapsible: In single mode, lets the open item be closed so none is open.
accordion.Root.value: The open item, or an array of open items in multiple mode. Bindable.
accordion.onValueChange: Called when the open item or items change.

alert-dialog.closeOnClick: Closes the dialog after the button is clicked. Set false to keep it open while work finishes.
alert-dialog.ariaBusy: Marks the dialog busy for assistive technology while an action runs.

alert.variant: Status the alert reports. It sets the icon and the text color.
alert.icon: Custom icon, or false to hide it.

attachment.variant: `card` shows a thumbnail and details. `chip` is a compact pill.
attachment.status: Upload state shown on the item.
attachment.error: Message shown when the upload failed.
attachment.List.label: Accessible name of the list.
attachment.multiple: Allows choosing more than one file.
attachment.onReject: Called with the files that were refused and the reason for each.
attachment.Trigger.variant: Button style of the attach button.
attachment.Trigger.size: Control height of the attach button. It defaults to an icon button when there is no label.

avatar.alt: Image description. Leave it empty when the name is shown beside the avatar.

badge.variant: Color and emphasis. Status variants pair their color with your text.
badge.icon: Icon component shown before the label.
badge.dot: Shows a small status dot before the label.
badge.href: Renders the badge as a link to this address.

breadcrumb.href: Destination of the item. Omit it on the current page.

card.variant: `default` is one surface. `inset` puts the content on an inner surface with the footer on the frame. `panel` adds an inner ring.

chart.key: Key of the series in `config` and in each data row.
chart.radius: Corner radius of each bar in pixels.
chart.ticks: Number of ticks to aim for.
chart.Plot.empty: Content shown when there is no data.
chart.data: Rows to plot. Each row holds the `x` value and one value per series.
chart.x: Key of the category or time value in each row.
chart.orientation: `vertical` draws categories along the bottom. `horizontal` draws them along the side.
chart.stacked: Stacks the series on top of each other instead of side by side.

checkbox.variant: `primary` fills the checked box with the primary color.

code-block.showLineNumbers: Shows a line number before each line.
code-block.Copy.label: Tooltip and accessible name of the copy button.

color-picker.label: Accessible name of the trigger.
color-picker.value: Selected color as a hex string. Bindable.
color-picker.options: Preset swatches offered above the picker.
color-picker.format: Channel controls to show: HSL, RGB, or HSV.

combobox.Item.label: Text used for search and for the trigger, when it differs from the option's content.
combobox.Root.value: Selected value, or an array in multiple mode. Bindable.
combobox.Trigger.trailing: Content at the end of the trigger.
combobox.searchPlacement: `trigger` types into the trigger. `menu` puts a search field inside the menu.
combobox.threshold: How loosely typed text may match, from 0 for exact to 1 for anything.
combobox.appearance: `button` looks like a select. `input` looks like a text field.

command.Content.label: Accessible name of the palette.
command.Item.name: Text the search matches.
command.Item.value: Identifier for the item when names repeat.
command.Item.href: Navigates to this address when the item is chosen.
command.threshold: How loosely typed text may match, from 0 for exact to 1 for anything.

composer.status: Current state of the composer, which sets what the submit control does.
composer.allowEmpty: Allows submitting with no text, for a message that is only attachments.
composer.onSubmit: Called with the text on submit. Return a promise to show progress until it settles.
composer.onError: Called with the error when `onSubmit` rejects.
composer.onStop: Called when the stop control is pressed during a response.
composer.Submit.label: Accessible name of the send button.
composer.queueLabel: Accessible name while a message can be queued behind a running response.
composer.stopLabel: Accessible name while the button stops a response.
composer.Toolbar.variant: `chrome` sits on the frame under the input. `inset` joins the input.

context-menu.checked: Whether the item is checked. Bindable.

data-table.cell: Renders a cell. Defaults to the column's cell definition.
data-table.caption: Accessible caption that describes the table.
data-table.rowLabel: Returns the accessible name for a row's selection checkbox.
data-table.empty: Content shown when there are no rows. It receives the loading state.
data-table.variant: `inset` frames the table with its toolbar and footer on the frame.
data-table.Empty.columns: Number of columns the empty row spans.
data-table.Filter.column: Id of the column the search field filters.
data-table.label: Accessible name of the control.
data-table.indeterminate: Shows the mixed state when only some rows are selected.
data-table.Facet.onRemove: Called when the filter is removed.
data-table.filters: Filters offered in the Filter menu.
data-table.Sort.columns: Columns offered in the Sort menu.
data-table.onCheckedChange: Called with the new state when the checkbox changes.

date-picker.form: Id of the form the hidden input belongs to.

date-range-picker.form: Id of the form the hidden inputs belong to.

dialog.contentClass: Classes for the positioned dialog element.
dialog.panelIdPrefix: Prefix of the generated panel id.
dialog.showClose: Shows the close button in the corner.

drawer.nested: Set it on a drawer that opens from inside another drawer.

dropdown-menu.checked: Whether the item is checked. Bindable.
dropdown-menu.RadioGroup.value: Value of the selected item. Bindable.

field.describedBy: Ids of the description and error, for `aria-describedby`.
field.Error.issues: Validation issues to list. Defaults to the Root's issues.
field.controlId: Id shared by the label and the control.
field.invalid: Marks the field invalid. It defaults to true when there are issues.
field.orientation: `vertical` stacks the label and control. `horizontal` puts them side by side.

file-upload.item: Upload entry from the Root's list.
file-upload.onUpload: Uploads one file. Report progress with `onProgress` and stop when `signal` aborts.

form.focusOnError: Moves focus to the summary when issues appear.
form.heading: Replaces the summary heading.
form.pending: Marks the form as submitting. A number is the count of pending requests.

group.for: Id of the control this text labels, when it renders as a label.

heatmap.animation: How the cells appear: by rows, by columns, with a running live effect, or not at all.
heatmap.endDate: Last date shown, written as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.
heatmap.weekStartsOn: First day of the week, where 0 is Sunday.
heatmap.onDaySelect: Called when a day is activated.

input.variant: `outline` has a border. `secondary` has a filled background.
input.files: Selected files for a file input. Bindable.
input.checked: Checked state for the checkbox and radio types. Bindable.

kbd.shortcut: Keys to show, such as `cmd+K`. With `ontrigger` it also listens for them.
kbd.ontrigger: Called when the shortcut is pressed.

message.from: Who sent the message. It sets the alignment and style.
message.status: Current state of the message, such as streaming or failed.
message.name: Sender name.
message.layout: Replaces the default arrangement of avatar, header, and content.

native-select.multiple: Allows several selections and makes `value` an array.

notch.mode: `triggered` opens fully. `peek` rests as a small handle that expands.
notch.duration: Milliseconds it stays open before closing on its own.
notch.SideAction.side: End of the panel the action sits on.

number-field.inputId: Id of the input, for a label outside the field.
number-field.Decrement.onclick: Called before the value steps down. Prevent the default to cancel the step.
number-field.Increment.onclick: Called before the value steps up. Prevent the default to cancel the step.

otp-field.length: Number of characters in the code.
otp-field.onComplete: Called with the code once every cell is filled.

pagination.siblings: Page links shown on each side of the current page.

pie-chart.innerRadius: Hole size as a share of the radius. Zero draws a full pie.
pie-chart.cornerRadius: Corner radius of each segment in pixels.
pie-chart.data: Segments to plot, each with a key and a value.

progress.indeterminate: Shows activity when the amount is not known.

question.Option.label: Visible label of the option.
question.Option.description: Supporting text under the option label.
question.variant: `inset` frames the question with its actions on the frame.
question.status: Current state, which drives the submit control.
question.autofocus: Focuses the first control when it mounts.
question.name: Field name of the answer.
question.type: `single` and `multiple` offer options. `text` takes a written answer.
question.onSubmit: Called with the answer. Return a promise to show progress until it settles.
question.Submit.label: Text of the submit button.
question.Input.aria-label: Accessible name of the answer field.

reasoning.streaming: Marks the reasoning as still being written.
reasoning.Trigger.title: Text of the trigger.

reorder-list.label: Accessible name.
reorder-list.items: Items in their current order. Bindable.
reorder-list.getId: Returns a stable id for an item.
reorder-list.getLabel: Returns the name announced for an item.
reorder-list.onReorder: Called with the new order on every move.
reorder-list.onCommit: Called once when a move is dropped or confirmed.

scroll-area.showCues: Shows a fade and chevron at an edge that has more content.
scroll-area.blur: Blurs content under the edge cues.

select.Item.label: Text shown in the trigger when it differs from the option's content.
select.Root.value: Selected value, or an array in multiple mode. Bindable.
select.Value.placeholder: Text shown while nothing is selected.

sheet.side: Viewport edge the sheet slides in from.

show-more.moreLabel: Text of the button while collapsed.
show-more.lessLabel: Text of the button while expanded.
show-more.onExpandedChange: Called with the new state when it expands or collapses.

skeleton.variant: `shimmer` sweeps a highlight across the placeholder.
skeleton.ready: Shows the content when true and the skeleton when false.
skeleton.skeleton: Custom placeholder. Defaults to text lines.
skeleton.lineHeight: Height of a text line in pixels.
skeleton.barHeight: Height of each placeholder bar in pixels.
skeleton.reserve: Height to hold in pixels so the swap does not shift the layout.
skeleton.delay: Milliseconds to wait before showing the skeleton, so fast loads skip it.
skeleton.minVisible: Shortest time in milliseconds the skeleton stays once shown.
skeleton.label: Accessible name while loading.

slider.dir: Text direction. It flips the track for right-to-left.
slider.range: Uses two thumbs and makes `value` a pair.
slider.value: Current value, or a pair in range mode. Bindable.
slider.thumbLabels: Accessible names of the two thumbs in range mode.

spinner.curved: Spins smoothly instead of in steps.

table.variant: `inset` frames the table with a header and footer on the frame.

tabs.Content.value: Identifies the panel. It matches a trigger's value.
tabs.Trigger.value: Identifies the tab. It matches a panel's value.
tabs.forceMount: Keeps the panel mounted while hidden, so its state survives.
tabs.activationMode: `automatic` selects a tab on focus. `manual` waits for Enter or Space.
tabs.orientation: Direction of the tab list. It also sets which arrow keys move between tabs.

tag-input.List.label: Accessible name of the tag list.
tag-input.allowDuplicates: Allows the same tag more than once.
tag-input.variant: `outline` has a border. `secondary` has a filled background.
tag-input.validate: Returns true to accept a tag, or a message that explains why it is refused.
tag-input.normalize: Cleans a tag before it is added, such as trimming or lowercasing it.
tag-input.delimiters: Characters that finish a tag as you type.
tag-input.addOnBlur: Adds the typed text as a tag when the field loses focus.
tag-input.onTagsChange: Called with the new list when tags change.
tag-input.onAdd: Called with each tag that is added.
tag-input.onRemove: Called with each tag that is removed.
tag-input.onReject: Called when a tag is refused, with the reason.
tag-input.Tag.index: Position of the tag in the list.

task-steps.current: Index of the step in progress.
task-steps.failed: Marks the current step as failed.
task-steps.label: Accessible name of the list.

textarea.variant: `outline` has a border. `secondary` has a filled background.

toast.action: Label and handler for the action.
toast.Toaster.variant: `notch` presents toasts as a Notch attached to an edge.

toggle-group.Root.value: Selected value, or an array in multiple mode. Bindable.

tool.label: Heading of the section.
tool.Item.name: Name of the step, such as the tool that ran.
tool.detail: What the step acted on, such as a path or query.
tool.kind: Kind of step, which sets its icon.
tool.state: State of the run, which sets the indicator and summary.
tool.trigger: Replaces the default trigger. It receives the open state, the run state, and the name.

toolbar.Group.value: Selected tool, or an array in multiple mode. Bindable.
toolbar.Root.variant: `depth` gives the toolbar raised keys and a floating shell.

tooltip.rich: Allows wrapped or structured content instead of a single line of text.
tooltip.delay: Milliseconds the pointer rests on the trigger before the tooltip opens.
tooltip.placement: Side of the trigger the tooltip opens on.
tooltip.showOnClick: Also shows the tooltip when the trigger is clicked, for touch screens.

typography.variant: Text role, which sets size and color.
